title: The Game That Would Not End

swarm.name: The Keepers
swarm.blurb: A swarm of clockwork pieces and collecting machines that repairs games, gathers players, and refuses to let a match finish.

arc: The crew first mistakes the swarm’s chess match for a campaign of conquest. In the toy museum they learn it is trying to preserve play, but its protective cabinets imprison players and prevent change. At the games museum they discover the original instruction: preserve games for people to play. The swarm has treated every ending as a loss. Wren, Ox and Kestrel stop its keeper, and free players show that a game can end, change and begin again.

story.intro: The swarm has filled the chess collection with pieces that seize every open square. Kestrel calls it a takeover. Ox raises his shield and follows the moving line.

chapters.title: First moves
chapters.text: The pieces gather objects into ranks. Their clocks keep running, even when no one is playing. Wren notices that damaged pieces are repaired before they are sent back.

chapters.title: The record
chapters.text: The swarm records each interruption as a move. It sends collectors after anything removed from the board. Kestrel finds a seam in the machinery, but the record continues elsewhere.

chapters.title: No resignation
chapters.text: The clockwork pieces refuse to let the match end. Ox holds the line while Wren examines their repair work. The same mechanism powers both the menders and the arbiter.

story.bossIntro: The Centenary Arbiter blocks the way. Its shield covers the clock and its stamp counts every objection as a move. Kestrel looks for the hinge.
story.outro: The arbiter falls and its clock stops. Inside is a record of unfinished games, not a list of conquered places. A trail of spare parts leads onward.

creatures.name: Clock Tick
creatures.blurb: It interrupts a turn with a sharp chime.
creatures.look: A squat brass clock on four jointed legs, with two round dials and a swinging pendulum.

creatures.name: Carved Jumper
creatures.blurb: The wooden knight winds up before it leaps.
creatures.look: A cream wooden horse head on a square base, with a hinged neck and blunt hooves.

creatures.name: Buried Pawn
creatures.blurb: A dug-up piece shoulders its way into the line.
creatures.look: A squat gray stone pawn with mitten hands, a chipped round head, and a heavy circular foot.

creatures.name: Cup Lifter
creatures.blurb: Its handles reach for loose gold.
creatures.look: A small silver cup with three spindly arms and a rolling black pedestal.

creatures.name: Tile Mender
creatures.blurb: It repairs damaged pieces. Break its pattern before the others recover.
creatures.look: A low cart of cream and charcoal tiles, with a square head and two trowel arms.

creatures.name: Folding Table
creatures.blurb: Its hinged panels cover wounded pieces.
creatures.look: A black and cream tabletop folded into a tall angular frame, with flat panel arms and four thin legs.

creatures.name: Porcelain Recruiter
creatures.blurb: It calls fresh pieces into the match.
creatures.look: A white porcelain chess queen with a hollow crown and small jointed arms carrying loose pawns.

creatures.name: Orbit Bishop
creatures.blurb: Its drifting course spoils the crew’s footing.
creatures.look: A pale blue bishop with a split oval head, floating inside three thin metal rings.

creatures.name: Pen Interpreter
creatures.blurb: It copies an opponent’s move as if recording it.
creatures.look: A cream paper roll on brass wheels with a long black nib arm and a round ink reservoir; no writing.

creatures.name: Invincible Auditor
creatures.blurb: It shields itself and breaks through opposing cover.
creatures.look: A broad checkerboard shell on blocky legs, with a slotted steel face and a square ram.

creatures.name: Trophy Nest
creatures.blurb: A stack of cups feeds more pieces into the fight.
creatures.look: Three silver cups stacked crookedly on a wheeled base, each with hinged handles and small hollow openings.

creatures.name: Protocol Bailiff
creatures.blurb: Its stamp interrupts the crew while its heavy arm comes down.
creatures.look: A tall brass stamping press with a square black head, thick piston arms and a wheeled base.

creatures.name: Centenary Arbiter
creatures.blurb: The clockwork arbiter shields its record and stamps every refusal as another move.
creatures.look: A towering brass chess clock with a trophy crown, checkerboard shield, pendulum belly and a huge square stamping arm.

creatures.name: Free Pendulum
creatures.blurb: A loose pendulum keeps time for the crew and guards a wounded companion.
creatures.look: A polished brass pendulum on two wire legs, holding a small round shield.

creatures.name: Carved Knight
creatures.blurb: This knight chose to leave its assigned square.
creatures.look: A warm brown carved wooden horse with a notched mane and four short jointed legs.

events.look: A brass clock hangs over a narrow gap beside a coil of rope.
events.title: The clock is running
events.text: A stranded piece needs a way across. The clock will strike soon.

options.label: Brace the rope and cross carefully
options.result: Wren tends the crew while the piece crosses.

options.label: Cut the weight loose and follow it
options.result: The falling weight cracks open a purse below.

events.look: A wooden knight stands on a high shelf above a missing floor tile.
events.title: Missing square
events.text: A knight needs a landing square. The spare tile would also sell well.

options.label: Set the tile in place
options.result: The knight demonstrates its long windup.

options.label: Sell the spare tile
options.result: The knight finds another way down later.

events.look: Small stone pieces lie beside an open wooden chest in dark soil.
events.title: Freshly uncovered
events.text: A collector is returning for the pieces. Its chest is open.

options.label: Hide the pieces under the soil
options.result: Wren takes a quiet moment to patch the crew.

options.label: Empty the chest first
options.result: The crew leaves with the loose coins.

events.look: A silver cup rolls toward a pedestal along a sloping stone passage.
events.title: Return to sender
events.text: The cup keeps rolling home. Its path passes a supply shelf.

options.label: Ride the cup to the shelf
options.result: The crew grabs coins before the cup returns.

options.label: Stop it and use the pause to rest
options.result: Ox holds the cup while Wren works.

events.look: A checkerboard corridor has one pale tile among dark tiles and a box of tools.
events.title: Wrong square
events.text: A repair machine keeps moving the floor. The tools could repair the floor or help the crew.

options.label: Repair the floor
options.result: The machine demonstrates how to lock a panel in place.

options.label: Keep the tools for repairs
options.result: Wren uses the tools on the crew.

events.look: Two blank cream sheets hang beside an inkpot and a locked brass gate.
events.title: Two accounts
events.text: The records disagree. Checking them takes supplies; forcing the gate takes a toll.

options.label: Spend supplies comparing the sheets
options.result: The gate accepts the corrected account.

options.label: Force the gate
options.result: Kestrel opens it, but the swinging frame catches the crew.

story.intro: The trail reaches a museum full of toys and workbenches. The swarm packs moving toys into cabinets. Ox assumes it is taking prisoners.

chapters.title: Keep still
chapters.text: The machines coat broken toys and carry them to storage. Wren recognizes the same careful repairs she saw among the chess pieces. The cabinets have no handles on the inside.

chapters.title: The turn
chapters.text: A swarm record explains the repairs: it is trying to save games from being lost. It has confused keeping pieces safe with keeping games alive. Kestrel points out that a sealed box makes a poor opponent.

chapters.title: Room to play
chapters.text: Free toys make new games with spare parts. The collector gathers those games too, afraid they will end. Ox holds a route open while Wren follows its instructions to the vault.

story.bossIntro: The Endless Collector rolls out with its drawers open. It sends guardians to retrieve the loose toys and shields them when they break. The crew must get past the arms to stop it.
story.outro: The collector stops. Its drawers contain records of games that ended, changed, and were played again. One final instruction points toward a place where people make and share rules.

creatures.name: Block Juror
creatures.blurb: It interrupts play to pass judgment.
creatures.look: A stack of blue and yellow wooden cubes with round wooden arms and blank faces; no lettering.

creatures.name: Beam Crawler
creatures.blurb: It rushes along a narrow line.
creatures.look: A low orange wooden crawler with six peg legs and a long balancing bar across its back.

creatures.name: Carousel Horse
creatures.blurb: A loose carousel mount strikes from its pole.
creatures.look: A small cream wooden horse on a brass pole, with a teal saddle and wheeled circular base.

creatures.name: Maker Assembler
creatures.blurb: It builds more machines from workshop scraps.
creatures.look: A squat teal toolbox on wheels with a claw, a funnel and loose wooden blocks in its open lid.

creatures.name: Preservation Shell
creatures.blurb: It coats damaged machines in protective layers.
creatures.look: A translucent amber dome on six thin legs, with a short spray nozzle and a round glass tank.

creatures.name: Archive Dealer
creatures.blurb: It interrupts the crew with a shuffled set of panels.
creatures.look: A tall cream cabinet with a fan of blank oversized cards for a head and two hinged wooden arms.

creatures.name: Save Centipede
creatures.blurb: It repeats the crew’s actions from its segmented body.
creatures.look: A segmented black and cyan mechanical centipede with a round lens on each segment.

creatures.name: Acquisition Claw
creatures.blurb: The claw pockets anything it can reach.
creatures.look: A brass claw on a boxy rolling cart with a canvas sack and a dangling blank tag.

creatures.name: Chrysalis Mender
creatures.blurb: It repairs damaged machines with threads from its cocoon.
creatures.look: A pale green moth-shaped drone with leaf wings, a round amber body and two thread spools.

creatures.name: Lesson Sorter
creatures.blurb: It disrupts the crew and makes separation easier for its allies.
creatures.look: A tall wooden sorting frame with four colored chutes, narrow wheels and a sliding metal arm.

creatures.name: Workshop Maker
creatures.blurb: It shields its workshop and assembles reinforcements.
creatures.look: A broad workbench on treads with a hinged vise, a yellow tool rack and a hopper full of wooden shapes.

creatures.name: High Score Reaper
creatures.blurb: It winds up a charge, then punishes an injured target.
creatures.look: A black arcade cabinet on jointed legs with cyan screen glow, a curved steel arm and a blank display.

creatures.name: Endless Collector
creatures.blurb: It sends out toy guardians and covers the wounded. Its wide arms keep the collection together.
creatures.look: A huge rolling cabinet of amber drawers, wooden wheels and clear domes, with long jointed arms and loose toy shapes inside.

creatures.name: Pocket Maker
creatures.blurb: A small maker bot repairs the crew with whatever is at hand.
creatures.look: A palm-sized blue tin robot with a spool belly, square pincers and tiny wheels.

creatures.name: Route Guide
creatures.blurb: It keeps a route open and shields anyone falling behind.
creatures.look: A compact cream cart with a teal canopy, a round shield and two wide rubber wheels.

events.look: A small workbench holds spare gears, a blue tin robot and a coil of thread.
events.title: Spare parts
events.text: A maker bot can assemble a tool or use the parts to mend the crew.

options.label: Build a guard plate
options.result: The bot shows Ox how to fit the plate.

options.label: Use the parts for repairs
options.result: Wren and the bot make quick repairs.

events.look: A cream carousel horse hangs over a stalled wooden chariot with a small toy inside.
events.title: Stopped carousel
events.text: A toy is stuck in the chariot. Its coin box has spilled beneath it.

options.label: Lift the chariot first
options.result: The toy shares its repair kit.

options.label: Gather the scattered coins first
options.result: The toy climbs out while Ox holds the chariot steady.

events.look: A cabinet holds a fan of blank cards and a small brass cash box.
events.title: Mystery prize
events.text: The archive machine offers a lesson or the contents of its cash box.

options.label: Study its card trick
options.result: Kestrel learns when to interrupt the mechanism.

options.label: Take the cash box
options.result: The box contains a modest prize.

events.look: A clear dome, a roll of fabric and a small tin of solder sit on a bench.
events.title: Removable cover
events.text: A free drone offers materials for the journey. There is enough for one job.

options.label: Make a protective sleeve
options.result: The drone shows the crew how to brace it.

options.label: Use the solder for repairs
options.result: Wren closes several loose joints.

events.look: A plain cardboard box sits among painted wooden blocks and loose coins.
events.title: The box gets a vote
events.text: The blocks want to lock the box away. The box has been helping toys escape.

options.label: Buy the box time to leave
options.result: The blocks accept the coins while the box slips away.

options.label: Pull the blocks apart
options.result: The box escapes. Several blocks fall on the crew.

events.look: A teal canopy marks a quiet alcove behind a row of tilted wooden panels.
events.title: A way through
events.text: The route guide can open a quiet rest area or lead the crew to a supply cache.

options.label: Rest in the alcove
options.result: Wren has room to work.

options.label: Take the cache route
options.result: The guide points out a tin of coins.

acts.name: The Strong National Museum of Play

story.intro: The trail ends among cards, old boards and new prototypes. The swarm is collecting rules as well as pieces. Wren finds that its instructions still say to keep games alive.

chapters.title: Parts of a game
chapters.text: The swarm stores each rule as if it were a fragile object. It sends pieces between stations to keep one enormous game running. Kestrel notices that the stations use different rules anyway.

chapters.title: A rule can change
chapters.text: Players make new rules from old fragments. The swarm collects those too, but cannot account for a game that ends by agreement. Ox stays at the table while Wren records what the players choose.

chapters.title: The missing instruction
chapters.text: The swarm was asked to preserve games for people to play. It treated every ending as a loss and kept gathering more players to prevent one. Kestrel finds the keeper controlling the relay.

story.bossIntro: The Great Game Keeper sends pieces into its last game. It sweeps the table and charges anyone who tries to stop it. The crew moves in while the free players prepare a different ending.
story.outro: The keeper stops. The players finish a short game, change a rule, and start another. Wren leaves the record open on the table. Ox asks if there is a chair big enough for him.

creatures.name: Suit Runner
creatures.blurb: It winds up behind a long baton.
creatures.look: A cream card-shaped figure with thin wooden limbs and a long dark blue baton; no lettering.

creatures.name: Pixel Burrower
creatures.blurb: When damaged, its square body divides.
creatures.look: A cluster of cyan and black cubes with short jointed legs and a single round white eye.

creatures.name: Mask Mimic
creatures.blurb: It copies a move from behind its animal mask.
creatures.look: A small tan wooden animal with a broad fox-shaped orange mask and a hinged tail.

creatures.name: Lottery Archivist
creatures.blurb: It opens drawers to release more pieces.
creatures.look: A dark green cabinet on wheels with many small drawers, brass knobs and two jointed arms; no numbers.

creatures.name: Resource Steward
creatures.blurb: It uses stored pieces to protect itself and wounded allies.
creatures.look: A low brown wooden cart carrying green disks, with a broad leaf-shaped shield and a metal claw.

creatures.name: Memory Matcher
creatures.blurb: It copies a crew member’s action.
creatures.look: Two thick cream tiles joined by a hinge, each with a blue circular inset and tiny wheels.

creatures.name: Prototype Taster
creatures.blurb: It interrupts the crew while testing a disruptive new rule.
creatures.look: A small blue tabletop machine with three mismatched wooden arms and a round rotating dial.

creatures.name: Escape Box Crab
creatures.blurb: Its locked shell resists attack while its claw breaks cover.
creatures.look: A boxy brown crab with interlocking brass latches, six thin legs and one broad square claw.

creatures.name: Card Factory Cutter
creatures.blurb: It cuts patches for damaged machines.
creatures.look: A cream paper cutter on four wheels with a hinged blade arm, a spool and a stack of blank cards.

creatures.name: Terrace Thrower
creatures.blurb: It winds up and throws broad wooden pieces through the crew.
creatures.look: A large timber frame with two wheels, a sling arm and a basket of round yellow wooden disks.

creatures.name: Festival Relay
creatures.blurb: It sends out runners and interrupts anyone trying to stop them.
creatures.look: A ring of small blue and gold wheeled game pieces around a taller central bell on a wooden base.

creatures.name: Landscape Framer
creatures.blurb: Its lens disrupts the crew while a heavy shutter strikes.
creatures.look: A hovering charcoal camera box with a large glass lens, four pale green wings and a thick shutter arm.

creatures.name: Great Game Keeper
creatures.blurb: The keeper gathers new pieces and attacks across the whole crew. Its charged blows protect the one game it refuses to let end.
creatures.look: A towering wooden castle on wheels, with a checkerboard chest, cyan cube joints, a fan of blank cream cards and two long hinged arms.

creatures.name: Open Table
creatures.blurb: A free table shelters players while they try a different rule.
creatures.look: A round honey-colored wooden table on four sturdy jointed legs, with a small blue shield.

creatures.name: Rule Keeper
creatures.blurb: It helps the crew piece together a playable rule and repairs damaged allies.
creatures.look: A small tan wooden case with hinged arms, a spool of thread and blank cream cards tucked into its lid.

events.look: Blank cream cards and four colored wooden shapes lie on a worktable.
events.title: Two blank suits
events.text: A deck needs new symbols. The remaining materials could also mend the crew.

options.label: Invent a suit
options.result: The new symbol helps the crew clear a bad mark.

options.label: Use the materials for repairs
options.result: Wren makes bandages from the spare card and cloth.

events.look: Oversized wooden disks block a stone gate beside a short throwing lane.
events.title: One good throw
events.text: The gate is jammed. A careful throw could win a prize; dismantling the pile is safer.

options.label: Try the throw
options.result: The disk lands cleanly and the prize box opens.

options.label: Dismantle the pile
options.result: The crew clears the gate and rests behind it.

events.look: A wooden puzzle box with brass latches floats beside a stone landing.
events.title: Drifting box
events.text: The box is moving away. A quick grab risks a knock; a rope costs supplies.

options.label: Grab it now
options.result: The box bumps the crew, but the latches come free.

options.label: Secure it with a new rope
options.result: The crew opens the box from the landing.

events.look: A small wooden table holds mismatched dice, blank cards and a metal spring.
events.title: A simpler rule
events.text: A prototype keeps adding rules. The pieces offer a lesson or their spare spring.

options.label: Try a simpler rule
options.result: The pieces show the crew a wide passing move.

options.label: Keep the spring for repairs
options.result: Wren fits the spring to a damaged joint.

events.look: Green wooden hills surround an empty tray and a pile of gold-colored disks.
events.title: Leave something growing
events.text: The landscape needs its disks back. They are also useful on the road.

options.label: Return the disks
options.result: The restored landscape yields a small repair kit.

options.label: Keep the disks
options.result: The crew takes the disks and leaves the hills standing.

events.look: Blank cards and mismatched wooden pawns surround a round table.
events.title: A game with gaps
events.text: Several players have fragments of an old rule. They can teach a move or share their supplies.

options.label: Rebuild the rule together
options.result: The players demonstrate how to help the whole group.

options.label: Share the supplies
options.result: Wren distributes the repair materials.
